name: hud_ui_message_box_dialog_on_ok
description: HudUiMessageBoxDialog::OnOk stores the OK modal result and clears the modal countdown.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf7c0 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bf7c0 validates modalResult = 1 at offset 0xa95c and modalFrameCountdown = 0 at offset 0xa960.
The native message-box leaf smoke verifies OnOk updates both fields.
